_generated_by: X-TL-DRAIN step 4, 2026-09-12 -- derived from gen_libmh_inbound's own caller table, not from a graph walk
_what: The THREE LIVE original callers X-TL-DRAIN translates. They are the surviving half of a 26-function batch whose other 22 members were measured provably dead and dispositioned on tools/data/reconciliation_pruned_roots.json instead (Scenario B, user ruling 2026-09-12). Each of the three is the only remaining thing keeping an already-owned body in the inbound surface's X-TL exclusion class -- an original->libmh crossing the fork would have had to export as an API entry purely because the CALLER had not been translated.
_why_members_and_not_roots: Exactly SIM1-H's shape and for exactly SIM1-H's reason. All three sit ABOVE the sim closure's
root -- llm_strat_bldg_init_all is boot stage 7, llm_strat_bldg_instant_construct_find_slot hangs
off llm_strat_input_update's build-placement click-confirm, llm_unit_order_disembark_soldiers off
the unit-state handler table -- so a forward walk from the root cannot reach them. Seeding them as
ROOTS would drag session entry, the input dispatcher and the boot stage list into a domain that has
closed twelve batches. Injected as members and nothing else: no walk, no descent, no widening.
AND NOTHING NEW COMES WITH THEM. Measured before seeding: their whole callee set is already ours or
already frontier -- llm_strat_bldg_init_defaults (sim, SIM1-H wave 1), llm_strat_order_dispatch /
So the batch TERMINATES at three functions and 781 bytes.
_the_fourth_live_row_is_not_here: llm_strat_order_queue_apply_and_dequeue is the batch's fourth live member and it is NOT in this
file, because it needs no translation: RI-ORDERS reimplemented it in libmh/orders/order_queue.cpp
before the migration-manifest era, and it carries both a shadow site and an MH_EXPORT_REPLACE
promotion seam. What it lacked was a LEDGER ROW -- which is why gen_libmh_inbound counted it as a
live ORIGINAL caller and three owned bodies stayed in X-TL on its account. Its row is seeded into
`orders_issue` instead (select.seeds, kind `names`), the domain sim.json's own
select.owned_elsewhere already names as its owner.
